# My Neuralgia

> An English-language patient blog about living with trigeminal neuralgia, trigeminal neuropathy, and chronic facial pain. Author: Natalia, living with trigeminal nerve pain since 2014. Content is educational and based on personal experience and medical literature — it does not replace medical consultation.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://myneuralgia.com/index.html): all articles
- [About](https://myneuralgia.com/about.html): author's story and blog mission
- [Start Here](https://myneuralgia.com/start-here.html): where to begin if you live with pain
- [Pain Diary (PDF)](https://myneuralgia.com/pain-diary.html): free printable template for tracking attacks, triggers, and medications
- [Privacy Policy](https://myneuralgia.com/privacy-policy.html)

## Topics

- Trigeminal neuralgia (symptoms, diagnosis, treatment)
- Trigeminal neuropathy and post-traumatic neuropathic facial pain
- Pharmacological treatment (carbamazepine, gabapentin, pregabalin), procedures (pulsed radiofrequency, microvascular decompression MVD), nerve blocks
- Living with chronic pain: daily life, emotions, support

## Note

Educational content only, not medical advice. In an emergency call 911. Mental health crisis: 988.
